request.prompt:
Deliverable: landscape flat system architecture infographic for a Chinese AI engineering article.
Primary request: show a customer-service system where the conversational LLM remains responsible for dialogue, while Jev handles key business decisions and calls business tools.
Composition: left title area and a right-to-left or top-to-bottom flow. A yellow box at top says "客户聊天" and flows into a teal "LLM" box. The LLM sends decision work to a coral "Jev (LDM)" box. Jev connects to a purple "订单系统" box and a dotted group of three tool cards: "售后工具", "业务代码", and "规则校验". The result flows back to a yellow box "LLM 回复客户". Arrows must be logically correct and readable.
Style and medium: flat-tech infographic inspired by Chinese architecture diagrams, warm off-white background, thick dark outlines, teal / coral / yellow modules, small hand-drawn star accents, no 3D, no photorealism.
Text (exact): Allowed readable text only: "客服机器人仍用 LLM", "关键决策点交给 Jev", "客户聊天", "LLM", "理解意图 · 对话生成", "Jev (LDM)", "决策 · 规划 · 调用工具", "订单系统", "售后工具", "业务代码", "规则校验", "LLM 回复客户", and "查询 / 更新". Render each exactly once. All other fields, order data, and UI text must be blank abstract placeholders.
Avoid: extra words, invented product names, duplicated labels, misspellings, watermark.
